mapper.sql: SELECT a.achievement_id, a.achievement_number AS management_no, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.occurred_date, a.certification_status, (a.attachment_ref IS NOT NULL) AS attachment_available, COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'degreeType', s.degree_type, 'studentName', s.student_name, 'thesisTitle', s.thesis_title, 'degreeAwardedDate', s.degree_awarded_date ) ORDER BY s.degree_awarded_date, s.degree_completion_student_id) FILTER (WHERE s.degree_completion_student_id IS NOT NULL), '[]'::jsonb) AS students FROM degree_completion_achievements a LEFT JOIN degree_completion_students s ON s.achievement_id = a.achievement_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots kps ON kps.employee_no = a.employee_no
mapper.select: WHERE a.achievement_number = #{managementNo} AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' GROUP BY a.achievement_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO degree_completion_achievements ( achievement_number, employee_no, evaluation_year, management_item_code, occurred_date, achievement_detail, certification_status, deleted_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{request.managementNo}, #{employeeNo}, #{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.managementItemCode}, #{request.occurredDate}, '{}'::jsonb, 'DRAFT', 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy} ) ON CONFLICT (achievement_number) DO UPDATE SET evaluation_year = EXCLUDED.evaluation_year, management_item_code = EXCLUDED.management_item_code, occurred_date = EXCLUDED.occurred_date, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

INSERT INTO degree_completion_students ( achievement_id, degree_type, student_name, thesis_title, degree_awarded_date, created_by ) VALUES
(#{achievementId}, #{student.degreeType}, #{student.studentName}, #{student.thesisTitle}, #{student.degreeAwardedDate}, #{createdBy})
